frontend_tests_summary: AI Agents page loads with data-testid='ai-agents-page'
3 agent tabs present: Business Agent, Coding Agent, Testing Agent
New Session button creates session and adds to sidebar
Session sidebar shows existing sessions with agent type badges
Coding Agent tab shows Backend/Frontend file browser buttons
Testing Agent tab shows quick test query buttons
File explorer modal opens and lists files correctly
Test query buttons run instant queries and display results
UniversalAI bar correctly hidden on /ai-agents page

sessions_api.POST /api/agents/sessions: 200 - Creates new session with id, agent_type, title, messages, timestamps
sessions_api.GET /api/agents/sessions/{id}: 200 - Returns session details, 404 if not found

testing_queries_api.POST /api/agents/testing/query: 200 - Supports 9 query types: full_health_check, tb_balance, entity_validation, project_health, timesheet_integrity, revenue_schedule, transaction_coverage, gst_compliance, collection_stats

coding_files_api.GET /api/agents/coding/files: 200 - Lists files in allowed directories, 403 for unauthorized
coding_files_api.POST /api/agents/coding/read-file: 200 - Returns file content, 403 for .env files, 404 for missing files

chat_api.POST /api/agents/chat: 200 - Returns Claude response with agent_type context, 400 for missing message or invalid agent_type
